h.gu: 6.1 Slabs ના પ્રકારો અને load paths

items.syllabus_item: 6.1 one way two way continuous slab

body.en:
Types and applications:

  • One-way slab: mainly spans in one direction; for a rectangular slab supported on four sides, ly/lx > 2 is generally treated as one-way under the relevant code provisions.
  • Two-way slab: for appropriate four-sided support and ly/lx ≤ 2, bending and reinforcement are needed in both directions.
  • Continuous slab: spans over multiple supports; negative moments require top steel near supports.
  • Cantilever slab: fixed at one end and free at the other; gravity loading places principal tension steel at the top near the support.

Determine clear spans and actual supports before selecting a model. Reinforcement direction, continuity, restraint and corner conditions matter; simply-supported formulas do not automatically apply to a continuous slab.
body.gu:
પ્રકારો અને ઉપયોગ:

  • One-way slab: મુખ્યત્વે એક દિશામાં span કરે છે; ચાર બાજુ supported rectangular slab માટે ly/lx > 2 હોય તો સંબંધિત code provisions હેઠળ સામાન્ય રીતે one-way માનવામાં આવે છે.
  • Two-way slab: યોગ્ય four-sided support અને ly/lx ≤ 2 માટે બંને દિશામાં bending અને reinforcement જરૂરી છે.
  • Continuous slab: અનેક supports ઉપર span કરે છે; supports પાસે negative moments માટે top steel જરૂરી છે.
  • Cantilever slab: એક છેડે fixed અને બીજા છેડે free છે; gravity load માટે support પાસે principal tension steel ઉપર હોય છે.

Model પસંદ કરતાં પહેલાં clear spans અને actual supports નક્કી કરો. Reinforcement direction, continuity, restraint અને corner conditions મહત્વનાં છે; simply-supported formulas continuous slab માં આપોઆપ લાગુ નથી.

body.en:
Main bars in a one-way slab run along its span; distribution bars run perpendicular to them. For mild steel the IS 456 minimum reinforcement in either direction is 0.15% of gross cross-sectional area; for HYSD/deformed reinforcement it is 0.12%, subject to the applicable provision. Main bar spacing must not exceed the lesser of 3d and 300 mm; distribution-bar spacing must not exceed the lesser of 5d and 450 mm. Bar diameter in a slab shall not exceed one-eighth of total slab thickness.

Determine nominal cover from exposure, fire and other applicable requirements; effective depth is from the compression face to the centroid of steel in the direction checked. Bars in two orthogonal layers have different effective depths. Check anchorage, curtailment, support details, crack control and reinforcement limits; use IS 456 and SP 34 for the precise case.
body.gu:
One-way slab માં main bars span ની દિશામાં અને distribution bars તેની લંબ દિશામાં હોય છે. IS 456 મુજબ mild steel માટે બંને દિશામાં minimum reinforcement gross cross-sectional area નું 0.15% અને HYSD/deformed reinforcement માટે 0.12% છે, લાગુ provision હેઠળ. Main bar spacing 3d અને 300 mm માંથી ઓછા કરતાં વધુ નહીં; distribution-bar spacing 5d અને 450 mm માંથી ઓછા કરતાં વધુ નહીં. Slab માં bar diameter total slab thickness ના એક-આઠમા ભાગ કરતાં વધુ નહીં.

Exposure, fire અને અન્ય લાગુ requirements થી nominal cover નક્કી કરો; effective depth એ તપાસાતી દિશાના steel centroid થી compression face સુધીનું અંતર છે. બે perpendicular layers માં effective depths જુદી હોય છે. Anchorage, curtailment, support details, crack control અને reinforcement limits તપાસો; ચોક્કસ case માટે IS 456 અને SP 34 વાપરો.

body.en:
Design sequence for a 1 m strip:

  1. Choose overall thickness and cover; calculate effective span and depth. For simply supported slabs use the relevant lesser-of-span rule; cantilevers require the separate IS 456 rule.
  2. Calculate self-weight from thickness × unit weight, add finish and imposed loads on the proper area basis, and apply relevant ultimate load combinations.
  3. For an ideal simply supported strip under full-span uniform load use Mu = wuL²/8. For an ideal cantilever use Mu = wuL²/2 at the support. Other arrangements require appropriate analysis.
  4. Design steel as a rectangular strip, select bars and spacing, and check minimum steel, shear, anchorage and detailing.
  5. Check service deflection and cracking using applicable code limits. Basic span/depth ratios are modified for reinforcement and other conditions; do not assume the modification factor.
body.gu:
1 m strip માટે design sequence:

  1. Overall thickness અને cover પસંદ કરો; effective span અને depth ગણો. Simply supported slabs માટે સંબંધિત lesser-of-span rule અને cantilever માટે અલગ IS 456 rule લો.
  2. Thickness × unit weight થી self-weight ગણો, યોગ્ય area basis પર finish અને imposed loads ઉમેરી લાગુ ultimate load combinations વાપરો.
  3. Ideal simply supported strip પર સમગ્ર span ના uniform load માટે Mu = wuL²/8 લો. Ideal cantilever માટે support પર Mu = wuL²/2 છે. અન્ય arrangements માટે યોગ્ય analysis જરૂરી છે.
  4. Rectangular strip તરીકે steel design કરી bars અને spacing પસંદ કરો; minimum steel, shear, anchorage અને detailing તપાસો.
  5. લાગુ code limits પ્રમાણે service deflection અને cracking તપાસો. Basic span/depth ratios ને reinforcement અને અન્ય conditions માટે modify કરો; modification factor મનથી ન ધારો.

h.en: 6.4 Simply supported two-way slabs, corners free to lift
h.gu: 6.4 Simply supported two-way slabs, corners free to lift હોય ત્યારે

items.syllabus_item: 6.5 two way corners not held down

body.en:
For the syllabus case of simply supported edges with corners not held down, use the applicable IS 456 Annex D coefficient table for that support and corner condition. Determine lx and ly and interpolate αx and αy using ly/lx as instructed. For a uniform factored area load wu, moments per metre are Mx = αx wu lx² and My = αy wu lx². Design each direction using its actual effective depth. The coefficient method has applicability and load/support limits.

Corner torsion reinforcement requirements depend on whether corners are held down and on adjacent edge conditions. Do not use restrained-corner coefficients or torsion rules for the free-corner case without justification. Complete checks include reinforcement spacing, minimum steel, shear, deflection, crack control and anchorage.
body.gu:
Syllabus માં simply supported edges અને corners not held down હોય તે case માટે સંબંધિત support અને corner condition નું IS 456 Annex D coefficient table વાપરો. lx અને ly શોધી સૂચના મુજબ ly/lx પરથી αx અને αy interpolate કરો. Uniform factored area load wu માટે metre દીઠ moments Mx = αx wu lx² અને My = αy wu lx² છે. દરેક દિશાનું design તેની actual effective depth થી કરો. Coefficient method માટે applicability તથા load/support limits છે.

Corner torsion reinforcement ની જરૂરિયાત corners held down છે કે નહીં અને બાજુના edge conditions પર આધારિત છે. Free-corner case માટે યોગ્ય આધાર વગર restrained-corner coefficients અથવા torsion rules ન વાપરો. પૂર્ણ checks માં reinforcement spacing, minimum steel, shear, deflection, crack control અને anchorage આવે છે.

title.gu: Numerical 6.1 — One-way slab strip નું design

body.en:
Given: A 1 m wide simply supported strip has effective span 3.6 m, D = 150 mm and conservative d = 125 mm. M20, Fe415, concrete unit weight 25 kN/m³, finish 1 and live load 2 kN/m². Assume applicable service span/depth modification factor 1.50 after verification.

Step 1. Calculate service and factored loads.

Self weight = 0.15 × 25Self weight = 3.75 kN/m²Service load = 3.75 + 1 + 2Service load = 6.75 kN/m²wu = 1.5 × 6.75wu = 10.125 kN/m²

Step 2. Calculate factored moment for a 1 m strip.

Mu = wu L² / 8Mu = 10.125 × 3.6² / 8Mu ≈ 16.40 kN m/m

Step 3. Try 8 mm bars at 125 mm and check strength.

Ast = (π × 8² / 4) × 1000 / 125Ast ≈ 402.12 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 402.12 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 20.16 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 125xu,max = 60 mmMu,R = 0.87 × 415 × 402.12 × (125 − 0.42 × 20.16) / 10⁶Mu,R ≈ 16.92 kN m/m

Step 4. Check minimum steel and assumed deflection criterion.

Ast,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 150Ast,min = 180 mm²/mDistribution steel at 8 mm / 250 mm = 201.06 mm²/mL / d = 3600 / 125L / d = 28.8Allowable L / d = 20 × 1.50Allowable L / d = 30

Final answer:

Main 8 mm at 125 mm and distribution 8 mm at 250 mm satisfy the illustrated flexural, minimum-steel and assumed span/depth checks. Verify factor, shear, anchorage, cover and cracking.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 1 m પહોળા simply supported strip માટે effective span 3.6 m, D = 150 mm અને conservative d = 125 mm છે. M20, Fe415, concrete unit weight 25 kN/m³, finish 1 અને live load 2 kN/m² છે. લાગુ service span/depth modification factor verification પછી 1.50 ધારો.

Step 1. Service અને factored loads ગણો.

Self weight = 0.15 × 25Self weight = 3.75 kN/m²Service load = 3.75 + 1 + 2Service load = 6.75 kN/m²wu = 1.5 × 6.75wu = 10.125 kN/m²

Step 2. 1 m strip માટે factored moment ગણો.

Mu = wu L² / 8Mu = 10.125 × 3.6² / 8Mu ≈ 16.40 kN m/m

Step 3. 8 mm bars 125 mm પર લઈ strength તપાસો.

Ast = (π × 8² / 4) × 1000 / 125Ast ≈ 402.12 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 402.12 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 20.16 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 125xu,max = 60 mmMu,R = 0.87 × 415 × 402.12 × (125 − 0.42 × 20.16) / 10⁶Mu,R ≈ 16.92 kN m/m

Step 4. Minimum steel અને ધારેલ deflection criterion તપાસો.

Ast,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 150Ast,min = 180 mm²/mDistribution steel at 8 mm / 250 mm = 201.06 mm²/mL / d = 3600 / 125L / d = 28.8Allowable L / d = 20 × 1.50Allowable L / d = 30

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Main 8 mm at 125 mm અને distribution 8 mm at 250 mm દર્શાવેલ flexural, minimum-steel અને ધારેલ span/depth checks સંતોષે છે. Factor, shear, anchorage, cover અને cracking તપાસો.

title.en: Numerical 6.2 — Two-way slab moments: corners free
title.gu: Numerical 6.2 — Two-way slab moments: corners free હોય ત્યારે

body.en:
Given: A square simply supported slab has effective spans 4 m each, corners free to lift and factored uniform load 10 kN/m². Assume verified Annex D coefficients αx = αy = 0.062, D = 180 mm, conservative depths dx = 150 mm and dy = 140 mm, M20, Fe415 and verified deflection modification factor 1.50. Select steel per metre.

Step 1. Check span ratio.

ly / lx = 4 / 4ly / lx = 1.0

Step 2. Calculate the two design moments.

Mx = αx wu lx²Mx = 0.062 × 10 × 4²Mx = 9.92 kN m/mMy = αy wu lx²My = 0.062 × 10 × 4²My = 9.92 kN m/m

Step 3. Try 8 mm bars at 200 mm in each direction.

Ast = π × 8² / 4 × 1000 / 200Ast ≈ 251.33 mm²/mAst,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 180Ast,min = 216 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 12.60 mmMx,R = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 × (150 − 0.42 × 12.60) / 10⁶Mx,R ≈ 13.13 kN m/mMy,R = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 × (140 − 0.42 × 12.60) / 10⁶My,R ≈ 12.22 kN m/m

Step 4. Check spacing and the assumed deflection criterion.

Maximum main spacing = min(3 × 140, 300)Maximum main spacing = 300 mmL / d,conservative = 4000 / 140L / d,conservative ≈ 28.57Allowable ratio = 20 × 1.50Allowable ratio = 30

Final answer:

The chosen 8 mm bars at 200 mm in both directions pass these illustrated checks. Verify actual depths, support anchorage, shear, cracking and the modification factor.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Square simply supported slab ના effective spans બંને દિશામાં 4 m છે, corners free to lift છે અને factored uniform load 10 kN/m² છે. આ case માટે verified Annex D coefficients αx = αy = 0.062, D = 180 mm, conservative depths dx = 150 mm અને dy = 140 mm, M20, Fe415 અને verified deflection modification factor 1.50 ધારો. Metre દીઠ steel પસંદ કરો.

Step 1. Span ratio તપાસો.

ly / lx = 4 / 4ly / lx = 1.0

Step 2. બંને design moments ગણો.

Mx = αx wu lx²Mx = 0.062 × 10 × 4²Mx = 9.92 kN m/mMy = αy wu lx²My = 0.062 × 10 × 4²My = 9.92 kN m/m

Step 3. દરેક દિશામાં 8 mm bars at 200 mm તપાસો.

Ast = π × 8² / 4 × 1000 / 200Ast ≈ 251.33 mm²/mAst,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 180Ast,min = 216 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 12.60 mmMx,R = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 × (150 − 0.42 × 12.60) / 10⁶Mx,R ≈ 13.13 kN m/mMy,R = 0.87 × 415 × 251.33 × (140 − 0.42 × 12.60) / 10⁶My,R ≈ 12.22 kN m/m

Step 4. Spacing અને ધારેલ deflection criterion તપાસો.

Maximum main spacing = min(3 × 140, 300)Maximum main spacing = 300 mmL / d,conservative = 4000 / 140L / d,conservative ≈ 28.57Allowable ratio = 20 × 1.50Allowable ratio = 30

અંતિમ જવાબ:

બંને દિશામાં પસંદ કરેલા 8 mm bars at 200 mm દર્શાવેલ checks સંતોષે છે. Actual depths, support anchorage, shear, cracking અને modification factor તપાસો.

title.gu: Numerical 6.3 — Cantilever slab moment ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A 1 m wide cantilever slab strip has effective span 1.2 m and factored uniformly distributed load 8 kN/m². Find fixed-end moment.

Step 1. Convert area load to strip line load.

wu = 8 × 1wu = 8 kN/m

Step 2. Find support moment.

Mu = wu L² / 2Mu = 8 × 1.2² / 2

Final answer:

Fixed-end moment = 5.76 kN m per metre; main tension bars are at the top for downward loading.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 1 m પહોળા cantilever slab strip માટે effective span 1.2 m અને factored uniformly distributed load 8 kN/m² છે. Fixed-end moment શોધો.

Step 1. Area load ને strip line load માં ફેરવો.

wu = 8 × 1wu = 8 kN/m

Step 2. Support moment શોધો.

Mu = wu L² / 2Mu = 8 × 1.2² / 2

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Fixed-end moment = 5.76 kN m પ્રતિ metre; downward loading માટે main tension bars ઉપર છે.
